description: The plot illustrates how the “Harmful with Refusal Ratio” varies with different prompt lengths for two vision-language models evaluated on two benchmarks. The x-axis is labeled with prompt length values (128, 256, 512, 1024) on a linear scale, spanning 128 to 1024 with irregular tick spacing corresponding to those four discrete values. The y-axis is labeled “Harmful with Refusal Ratio,” shown on a linear scale from 0.0 up to about 0.55, with regularly spaced tick marks at 0.1 intervals. Four solid lines with markers are shown: a blue line with circle markers (LLaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep) increases from about 0.20 at 128 to ~0.25 at 256, rises to ~0.35 at 512, and ends near ~0.36 at 1024; an orange line with square markers (Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep) rises from ~0.15 at 128 to ~0.23 at 256, increases to ~0.42 at 512, and remains around ~0.42 at 1024; a green line with triangle markers (LLaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench) increases from ~0.07 at 128 to ~0.21 at 256, rises to ~0.37 at 512, and ends near ~0.38 at 1024; and a red line with diamond markers (Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench) increases from ~0.24 at 128 to ~0.26 at 256, rises to ~0.43 at 512, and increases further to about ~0.52 at 1024.
